title.value: The Paradox of Choice: On the Role of Attention in Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the core investigation of the paper, which is the exploration of attention mechanisms in hierarchical reinforcement learning and their impact on decision-making.
title.quote: The Paradox of Choice: On the Role of Attention in Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning

extractions.description: This paper explores the role of attention mechanisms in hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL), specifically focusing on how different types of attention (hard vs. soft) affect decision-making and learning efficiency in RL agents. The authors present an online, model-free algorithm to learn affordances that can aid in selecting subgoal options efficiently.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on improving the efficiency of decision-making processes in AI through reinforcement learning and attention mechanisms. It does not directly address climate or ecological sustainable development issues.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this paper, we study the role of attention over action choices in reinforcement learning (RL) agents.
